item.title: Scratch Tickets With Your Friends 🎰
item.description: A chaotic simulation where rent keeps rising and your money keeps disappearing. Scratch lottery tickets, sort junk, upgrade your setup, and make questionable decisions to survive another day. 🎰💸

item.title: Spellcaster University - Gears and Gobelins
item.description: Dive into an epic new chapter of Spellcaster University's magical world with the "Steam Age" expansion!

item.title: The RPG
item.description: Minimalistic Skyrim + West of Loathing + Supraland. An RPG-lite adventure with intentionally twisted traditional role-playing games aspects, where your choices do matter.

item.title: Explosive Odds - Supporter Pack
item.description: The Explosive Odds Supporter Pack provides a few extra costumes. If you like the game and you like us and you want to give us more money here's your chance! Comes with two Pig Bot hats and the test hat!
